visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.pauseHelp: You disappear from discovery. Your conversations stay available.
visibility.incognitoHelp: Only people you liked can see your profile.
visibility.hideSchool: Hide me from students of my school
visibility.hideSchoolHelp: Neither you nor they will see each other in discovery.
visibility.hideYearHelp: People from your school and class won't see you, and vice versa.
visibility.partialsHelp: A scheduled pause: notifications go quiet and your profile comes back by itself on the chosen date.
visibility.pausedUntil: Paused until {date}. You'll come back automatically.
visibility.partialsInvalid: Pick a date between tomorrow and two months from now.

discovery.title: Who I see

consentState.none: No sensitive-data consent: Friends mode only

discovery.withdrawHelp: Love mode is switched off and the genders you're looking for are erased.

hidden.title: Hidden people
hidden.lead: An ex, a flatmate, a sibling, a teaching assistant: add their school email and you'll never see each other. They're not told, and we only keep a fingerprint of the address.
hidden.label: School email to hide
hidden.invalid: An EPITA, ESME, Sup'Biotech, ISG or IPSA address is needed.
hidden.tooMany: You've reached the maximum number of hidden addresses.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.discreetHelp: No first name or content in notifications: just "New message".

language.title: Language
language.hint: The Epilove interface and emails. Your choice follows your account on all your devices.

lock.title: App lock
lock.toggle: Lock the app on this device
lock.toggleHelp: When opening it and after a while in the background. Handy if you lend your phone. The setting stays on this device.

passkey.label: Face ID, fingerprint or device code

pin.label: An Epilove code
pin.help: 4 to 6 digits, different from your phone code.

lock.noPasskey: First add a passkey in the Security section to use biometrics.
lock.pinMismatch: The two codes do not match.
lock.pinInvalid: The code must have 4 to 6 digits.
lock.enabled: App lock is on for this device.

screen.title: Epilove is locked
screen.passkeyFailed: The check did not go through. Try again.
screen.wrongPin: Wrong code. {left, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}} left before signing out.
screen.forgotHelp: You will sign in again with your school address; the lock will be removed from this device.

data.title: My data
data.deleteHelp: Immediate and final: your profile disappears at once and your data is erased within 30 days.
data.dialogBody: Your profile, photos, likes and conversations disappear. Only your declared identity (email, first name, date of birth) is kept separately for the legal period, then erased.
data.exportHelp: A zip file with your profile, photos, consents and the history about you. We email you when it's ready.
data.exportRequested: On it: you'll get an email within a few minutes.
data.exportRateLimited: You've already asked for two exports today.

deleted.title: Your account is deleted.
deleted.body: Your profile is no longer visible and your data will be erased within 30 days. Thanks for stopping by.

suspended.title: Your account is suspended.
suspended.body: A moderation decision was taken. You received its reasons by email, and how to contest it.
suspended.appeals: See the decision and contest it

appeals.title: Decisions and appeals
appeals.lead: Moderation decisions about you, with their reasons. You can contest each one once within six months: someone else on the team reviews it.
appeals.formLabel: Explain why the decision seems unjustified
appeals.sent: Appeal sent. You'll get the answer by email.

reverify.banner: New year: confirm your school address before {date}.
reverify.paused: Your profile is paused: confirm your school address to show up again.
reverify.title: Still on campus?
reverify.lead: Every new academic year, we check you can still access your school address. We'll send a code to {email}.
reverify.done: Confirmed, thanks! See you next year.
reverify.error: Wrong or expired code. Ask for a new one.
